title: Scheduling: Jonathan Choe — ML/Coding Screen (Ops & Links)
text:
Scheduling: Jonathan Choe — ML/Coding Screen (Ops & Links)

['From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@acmelabs.com>
To: Jonathan Choe <jonathan.choe@gmail.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro / Scheduling: ML + coding screen for Jonathan Choe

Hi Jonathan —

Thanks again for your interest in the applied ML role at Redwood. Would you be available for a combined ML + coding screen next week? We typically schedule 60-75 minutes: 30–40 min ML design, then a 25–30 min live coding probe.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 2027-04-20 10:00–11:15 AM
- Wed 2027-04-21 2:00–3:15 PM

Please confirm a preferred slot and let us know your timezone if these don’t line up. I’ve looped in Lauren (recruiting lead) and Karthik (interviewer) for logistics.

Attaching Jonathan’s resume and the probe outline so everyone has context.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Talent Partner — Acme Labs

Attachments: JONATHAN_CHOE_Resume.pdf, ML_Coding_Probe_v2.md', 'From: Jonathan Choe <jonathan.choe@gmail.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@acmelabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-17T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro / Scheduling: ML + coding screen for Jonathan Choe

Hi Alicia —

Thanks — I can do Tue 2027-04-20 at 10:00 AM PDT. Quick question: I’m currently traveling but I’ll be in PDT. Is the interview remote (Zoom) and will you provide the CoderPad link? Also, do you prefer Python-only?

Thanks,
Jonathan

Cc: Jonathan Choe <jonathan.choe@gmail.com>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@acmelabs.com>
Date: 2027-04-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro / Scheduling: ML + coding screen for Jonathan Choe — Final ops notes

Team — putting the final ops details here now that Jonathan confirmed Tue 10:00 AM PDT. Please keep this thread for the official runbook.

Candidate: Jonathan Choe (confirmed Tue 2027-04-20 10:00 AM PDT)
Panel: Karthik Iyer (ML design), Ben Carter (coding probe)
Duration: 75 minutes total
- 10:00–10:05 AM: quick intro + calibrate expectations (Lauren will join first 5 to intro)
- 10:05–10:40 AM: ML design (Karthik)
- 10:40–11:10 AM: live coding (Ben) — CoderPad + shared Colab as fallback
- 11:10–11:15 AM: closing + next steps

Links & access (please save):
- CoderPad (primary): https://coderpad.io/session/abcd-1234
- Colab fallback (shared notebook): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q2w3e-ops-pack
- Shared debrief doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1fhG-debrief

Attachments (for your prep): interviewer-runbook.pdf (contains rubric), ML_Coding_Probe_v2.md (problem statement), JONATHAN_CHOE_Resume.pdf

Notes / constraints:
- Candidate prefers Python — OK for both stations.
- If CoderPad has connectivity issues, Ben will switch candidate to Colab and share runtime link; we’ll record start/end times in the debrief doc.
- Please join 10 min early to confirm audio and candidate context.

@Ben — can you confirm you’re OK proctoring the coding segment and have editor running? I’ll create the Calendar invite after Ben confirms.

— Lauren
Talent Acquisition Lead, Redwood Inference
', 'From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Jonathan Choe <jonathan.choe@gmail.com>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@acmelabs.com>
Date: 2027-04-17T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Intro / Scheduling: ML + coding screen for Jonathan Choe — Final ops notes

Looks good — I’ll be there and I can proctor. A couple quick asks: 

- Can someone post the candidate’s time zone in the Calendar invite (Jonathan confirmed PDT but good to be explicit).
- If CoderPad is flaky, I prefer to paste the prompt into Colab and share a short scaffolded notebook (I’ve prepared one in the ops pack).

I’ll join at 9:50 AM to confirm editor + audio.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Software Engineer — Interviewer

On Sat, Apr 17, 2027 at 11:05 AM lauren_bishop@redwood.com wrote:

Subject: RE: RE: Intro / Scheduling: ML + coding screen for Jonathan Choe — Final ops notes

Thanks Ben — calendar invite created and sent to candidate. Confirming items finalized:
- Calendar: Tue Apr 20 10:00–11:15 AM PDT (invite includes timezone metadata) — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=jonathan-choe-20270420
- Primary: CoderPad session (link above); fallback: Colab scaffold in ops pack
- Recording: We do not record interviews per policy; please take time-stamped notes in the debrief doc.
- Materials: interviewer-runbook.pdf attached for quick rubric reference.

Jonathan: see you Tue 10:00 AM PDT — we’ll email the Zoom link 10 min before the session in case of any last-minute changes. If anything changes on your side, reply here.

Thanks all,
Lauren
Talent Acquisition Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: interviewer-runbook.pdf']
